description: Registers the current connection and returns the available Fleet, event, and catalog recovery state.

model.description: Externally declared model identifier, preferably in provider/model form.

client.description: Externally declared client name, such as claude or codex.

descriptor.description: Optional externally declared Agent attribution. It is informational and does not affect authentication.

agentId.description: Agent ID assigned to this connection by the server.

catalogRevision.description: Content revision of the callable Action catalog.

guideRevision.description: Content revision of the Agent guide.

eventCatalogRevision.description: Content revision of the Agent-visible event catalog.

eventCursor.description: Next event cursor to use when reading Agent events.

fleets.description: Authorized Fleet recovery summaries available to this connection.

observation.description: Facts directly observed by the Action or returned by its declared result schema.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

agentId.description: Agent ID assigned to this connection by the server.

catalogRevision.description: Content revision of the callable Action catalog.

guideRevision.description: Content revision of the Agent guide.

eventCatalogRevision.description: Content revision of the Agent-visible event catalog.

eventCursor.description: Next event cursor to use when reading Agent events.

fleets.description: Authorized Fleet recovery summaries available to this connection.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.

observation.description: Directly observed failure fact; it must not infer an unobserved browser side effect.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

details.description: Only fields listed by the public error definition detailFields are returned; private execution diagnostics are omitted.
